title: Moime.app
summary: A link-in-bio page for promo codes and events. Point it at a flyer and it reads the dates, codes and venue off the image instead of asking you to type them.
thesis: A link-in-bio page can do more than list links — it can read event details straight off a flyer image instead of asking the user to retype them.
experiment: Built a link-in-bio page for promo codes and events in React 19 with a serverless backend; Gemini reads dates, codes, and venue off a flyer image.
question: Can image-reading AI reliably extract structured event details — dates, codes, venue — from an arbitrary flyer well enough to remove manual entry?

mine: Designed a link-in-bio page for promo codes and events
Built the flyer-image parsing that extracts dates, codes, and venue with Gemini
Built the app in React 19 with a serverless backend
